tags.name: Boulders
tags.qa_note: Re-audited: depth conflicts across sources (15-50m reported); corrected pygmy seahorse claim to general seahorses (only McFadyen specified pygmy); dropped uncorroborated clownfish/razorfish.

tags.name: Dry Dock
tags.qa_note: Re-audited: removed uncorroborated beer-bottle-crate artificial reef claim and turtle sightings (single-source only). PADI dates scuttling to 1998 (single source, attributed).

tags.name: Dungon Wall
tags.qa_note: Re-audited: corrected max depth from 35m to 30m (2 of 3 sources agree; McFadyen's 35m+ noted as outlier). Added corroborated catamaran wreck feature (PADI+actiondivers). Removed uncorroborated featherstars/clownfish/100m-length claims.

tags.name: Ernies Cave
tags.qa_note: Re-audited: removed uncorroborated scuttled-vessel/wreck claim (not mentioned by PADI or Action Divers, both of which describe the site as overhang+reef only). Removed uncorroborated garden eels and Christmas tree worms.

tags.name: Fantasea
tags.qa_note: Re-audited: removed unconfirmed rare white Rhinopias frondosa claim and scuttled-tinnies artificial reef claim (not corroborated by PADI or Zentacle). Removed uncorroborated orangutan crabs/mantis shrimp/banded sea snakes. Depth conflict noted (15-27m across sources).

tags.name: Hole in the Wall
tags.qa_note: Re-audited: significant depth conflict across sources (PADI cites 5-15m for the tunnel zone, Action Divers 10-20m, McFadyen 27m overall) -- flagged in description rather than picked. Softened 'jacks' schooling claim to general schooling fish (only McFadyen names jacks specifically).

tags.name: Kilima
tags.qa_note: Re-audited: thresher shark claim corroborated by PADI (seasonal, February) in addition to McFadyen -- strengthened. Removed uncorroborated humphead wrasse and banded sea snake claims. Added PADI-sourced pygmy seahorse mention (single-source, attributed).

tags.name: Montani
tags.qa_note: Re-audited: entry type and current character conflict across sources (McFadyen: shore entry, gentle drift; PADI: boat entry, current-protected) -- flagged rather than resolved. Removed unverifiable 81-minute dive anecdote and uncorroborated water-pipe claim. Removed uncorroborated gobies/cowfish/banded sea snakes/dancing shrimp/flatworms. Added PADI+Casalay-corroborated wonderpus, blue-ringed octopus, flamboyant cuttlefish (occasional).

tags.name: MV Alma Jane
tags.qa_note: Re-audited with full wreck-history cross-check: vessel length ~30-32m, ~60 tons, built Japan 1966, deliberately sunk March 2003 by the Puerto Galera Dive Association off Small La Laguna Beach at ~30m -- corroborated across badladz.com and asiadivers.com (operator/local sources); no Wikipedia article exists for this vessel. Removed uncorroborated turtle sightings; batfish-at-bow and sweetlips confirmed by 2+ independent sources.

tags.name: Sabang Bay West
tags.qa_note: Re-audited: could not find independent corroborating sources beyond michaelmcfadyenscuba.info for this specific sub-site (the 'two dumped aluminium boats' feature and site name were not found on any other operator or database page checked). Left validated as-is per policy against padding weak sources; flagged as unresolved for the 3-source bar.

tags.name: Sabang Bay Wrecks
tags.qa_note: Re-audited: corrected wreck composition -- sources agree on 3 wrecks with a mix of steel-hulled and wooden-hulled vessels (not simply 'several scuttled small vessels'). Removed uncorroborated black giant anglerfish and peacock razorfish claims (not found in PADI or BADLADZ accounts); turtles confirmed by 2 sources but 'with remoras' detail dropped as unconfirmed.

tags.name: Sabang Point
tags.qa_note: Re-audited: removed uncorroborated porcupinefish, garden eels, and egg cowries (not mentioned by PADI or Capt'n Gregg's). Added PADI-corroborated pygmy seahorses and blue ribbon eels.

tags.name: Shark Cave
tags.qa_note: Re-audited: PADI confirms the site's name derives from a cavern that historically housed white-tip reef sharks, consistent with the existing note that sharks are not commonly seen today. The Atoll formation corroborated by a second independent source.

tags.name: Sinandigan Wall
tags.qa_note: Re-audited: removed uncorroborated thresher shark claim for this specific site (not mentioned by PADI or Infinity Resort, unlike nearby Kilima where it is corroborated). Removed uncorroborated yellow sea cucumbers. Wall-length claim (~50m) conflicts with a source describing the wall as 'not very long' -- flagged as a conflict rather than resolved.

tags.name: The Canyons
tags.qa_note: Re-audited: corrected anchor description from 'Admiralty anchor' to 'Spanish anchor' -- confirmed by 2 independent sources (PADI, BADLADZ), contradicting the prior single-source claim. Removed uncorroborated whale shark sighting claim; replaced with manta ray, thresher shark, and hammerhead shark sightings, each corroborated by 2 independent sources.

tags.name: West Escareo
tags.qa_note: Re-audited: removed uncorroborated banded sea snakes and orangutan crabs/bubble coral claims. Added PADI-corroborated blue-spotted stingrays, scorpionfish, octopus, puffer fish, groupers, triggerfish.
